rules.name: schema-02-structure-dev-vs-uat
rules.sql: SELECT 'table' AS kind, c.relname AS name, md5(string_agg(a.attname || ':' || format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) || ':' || a.attnotnull::text || ':' || coalesce(pg_get_expr(ad.adbin, ad.adrelid), ''), ',' ORDER BY a.attnum)) AS def_hash FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef ad ON ad.adrelid = c.oid AND ad.adnum = a.attnum WHERE n.nspname = :schema AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p') AND NOT c.relispartition GROUP BY c.relname UNION ALL SELECT 'view', c.relname, md5(pg_get_viewdef(c.oid)) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = :schema AND c.relkind IN ('v', 'm') UNION ALL SELECT 'function', p.proname || '(' || pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) || ')', md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = :schema AND p.prokind IN ('f', 'p') UNION ALL SELECT 'trigger', c.relname || '.' || t.tgname, md5(pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid)) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = :schema AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND NOT c.relispartition UNION ALL SELECT 'index', ic.relname, md5(pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid)) FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = i.indrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = :schema AND NOT c.relispartition UNION ALL SELECT 'constraint', c.relname || '.' || k.conname, md5(pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid)) FROM pg_constraint k JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = k.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = :schema AND NOT c.relispartition AND k.contype <> 't'

SELECT 'table' AS kind, c.relname AS name, md5(string_agg(a.attname || ':' || format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) || ':' || a.attnotnull::text || ':' || coalesce(pg_get_expr(ad.adbin, ad.adrelid), ''), ',' ORDER BY a.attnum)) AS def_hash FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef ad ON ad.adrelid = c.oid AND ad.adnum = a.attnum WHERE n.nspname = :schema AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p') AND NOT c.relispartition GROUP BY c.relname UNION ALL SELECT 'view', c.relname, md5(pg_get_viewdef(c.oid)) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = :schema AND c.relkind IN ('v', 'm') UNION ALL SELECT 'function', p.proname || '(' || pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) || ')', md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = :schema AND p.prokind IN ('f', 'p') UNION ALL SELECT 'trigger', c.relname || '.' || t.tgname, md5(pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid)) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = :schema AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND NOT c.relispartition UNION ALL SELECT 'index', ic.relname, md5(pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid)) FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = i.indrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = :schema AND NOT c.relispartition UNION ALL SELECT 'constraint', c.relname || '.' || k.conname, md5(pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid)) FROM pg_constraint k JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = k.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = :schema AND NOT c.relispartition AND k.contype <> 't'

expect.reason: every object in dev should also be in UAT (dev and UAT are supposed to be the same)
every object in UAT should also be in dev (dev lost triggers and indexes in the last migration)
